cohort: 1800 women aged 20-35 years with term premature rupture of membranes were included in the study.
finding: Induction of labor in term prelabor rupture of membranes results in better maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: The induction group had a higher rate of spontaneous vaginal delivery (91.0% vs 86.22%) and a lower rate of caesarean section (9.0% vs 13.78%) compared to the expectant management group.
